craft_notes: Sthāyin: potter proof — the ahnika's hinge. Rows: maker, question, answer. Rejected: sparing the paradox — killed: paradox is the proof. Read aloud: hammered logic.

lines: world-stuff bodied, pots and the like he builds —
for pot-mind is nothing beyond him,
and the pot-body cast amid thing-masses —
Then thus: the Highest-made even that shall be, like pots and the like.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ity evaṃ saṃvedanasvātantryasvabhāvaḥ parameśvara eva viśvabhāvaśarīro ghaṭāder nirmātā kumbhakārasaṃvidas tato 'nadhikatvāt kumbhakāraśarīrasya ca bhāvarāśimadhye nikṣepāt kathaṃ kumbhakāraśarīrasya kartṛtvābhimānaḥ iti cet parameśvarakṛta evāsau ghaṭādivat bhaviṣyati
